in_sanskrit.name: Gunjitā
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gunjita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'gunja' meaning 'joy, delight'. The name 'Gunjita' is formed by adding the feminine suffix '-itā' to the word 'gunja'. The name signifies a joyful and delightful woman.
